jobs.description: KelvionUnsere Mission ist es, mit Innovationskraft und Nachhaltigkeit die industrielle Transformation voranzutreiben. jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.Your roleAs a Global Category Manager for Site Services, you will sit at the heart of a worldwide Technical Sourcing organization, shaping the procurement strategies that underpin some of the most significant capital and operational investments across a global science and technology enterprise. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for an experienced procurement professional who thrives on complexity, drives value at scale, and influences outcomes across organizational boundaries without relying on direct authority.You will own and continuously evolve the global category strategy for Site Services – spanning Equipment and Components, Construction, and Energy – directly aligned to capital investment plans and long-term business priorities. Applying a spend entrepreneurship mindset, you will lead rigorous end-to-end sourcing programs: from market analysis, supplier segmentation, and total cost of ownership modeling through to contract conclusion and claim management.You will build and govern a high-performing strategic supplier portfolio, establish structured supplier relationship management programs with clear key performance indicator frameworks and governance cadences, and ensure resilient, multi-region supply continuity. Acting as a trusted counterpart toManufacturing, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders across all business sectors, you will coordinate virtual global category teams across the Americas, Europe, and Asia – generating cross- project synergies and delivering quantifiable, sustained value improvements with full transparency to senior leadershipWho you are• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent professional experience is equally valued.• 8–12+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing and category management, with a strong track record in indirect, technical, or engineering-related procurement within complex, multinational environments – ideally in life sciences, healthcare, or electronics.• Demonstrated expertise in developing and executing global category strategies, including capital expenditure and operational expenditure procurement, supplier relationship management, contract negotiations, and multi-region supplier governance.• Exceptional analytical and commercial acumen: fluency in total cost of ownership modeling, spend analytics, should-cost analysis, and advanced negotiation strategies, with the ability to translate technical requirements into compelling procurement solutions.• Outstanding stakeholder management and influencing skills; proven ability to lead without formal authority in a matrixed global organization and to present data-driven business cases to senior leadership.• Solid understanding of compliance-intensive environments, including Good Manufacturing Practice standards and sustainable procurement practices aligned to environmental, social, and governance principles.• Demonstrated ability to engage with artificial intelligence tools and concepts – including their practical applications, limitations, and ethical implications – to support informed, responsible decision-making in a procurement context.• Business fluency in English is required; proficiency in German, French, Mandarin, or other languages is a distinct advantage.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

Job DescriptionAs an Equipment Engineer within the EGIO area, you will be responsible for ensuring the technical availability, performance, and continuous improvement of highly complex production equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing. Through proactive problem-solving, equipment optimization, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams, you will contribute directly to manufacturing excellence, product quality, and the company's overall competitiveness.You will join a highly skilled and interdisciplinary team of approximately 40 engineers, technicians, and support specialists. personal development can thrive.Key ResponsibilitiesEquipment Ownership- Provide technical support, optimization, and further development of production equipment within the EGIO area (Epitaxy, Glass preventive maintenance and repair activities.Process and Quality Optimization- Analyze equipment and process data to identify improvement opportunities.- Develop and implement initiatives to improve: - OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)- MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)- MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)- Process Capability (Cp/Cpk)- Yield and Product Quality- Perform statistical analyses and implement equipment upgrades and retrofit programs.- Collaborate with equipment manufacturers, suppliers, and external service providers.- Prepare technical specifications and requirement documents.Production Support- Support escalation management within the manufacturing environment.- Deliver technical training for operators and maintenance technicians.Other Responsibilities- Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality standards.- Maintain equipment performance in line with production targets.- Reduce unplanned equipment downtime.- Document technical modifications and engineering changes.- Support audits and ensure compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements.EducationBachelor’s or Master’s degree in one of the following disciplines:- Electrical/ Mechanical/ Microsystems/Process Engineering- Physics- Materials Science- Or a comparable technical fieldProfessional Experience- Minimum 3 years of experience in the semiconductor industry or a comparable high-tech manufacturing environment.- Practical experience in at least one of the EGIO responsibility areas.Technical Expertise- Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes.- Knowledge of SPC (Statistical Process Control), FDC (Fault Detection and Classification), APC (Advanced Process Control), and data analytics.- Experience with MES and ERP systems.- Familiarity with vacuum technology, high-temperature processes, gas delivery systems, and cleanroom technologies.- Ability to interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, and engineering specifications.Personal Competencies- Strong analytical and structured approach to problem-solving.- High level of initiative and ownership.- Ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams.- Excellent communication skills across all organizational levels.- Resilience and flexibility in a dynamic manufacturing environment.- Continuous Improvement mindset.Language Skills- Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.- Ability to communicate effectively with international suppliers and development partners.Reporting Line: Service & Maintenance Managers and the Section That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.Your RoleAs a Principal Scientist in the Structural Biology and Biophysics team, R&D Discovery, you will provide scientific leadership in interdisciplinary projects to elucidate structural mode of action and enable structure-based design with a focus on macromolecular complexes of antibodies, multispecifics and molecular degraders.
